chunks: O you, the offspring of those We bore (in the ark) with Noah, he was indeed a grateful votary.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Noah's character and his descendants?
ai.summary: In Surah Al- Isra, God addresses the descendants of Noah, affirming his status as a 'grateful servant' (abdun shakur) to validate the continuity of prophetic lineage. Shia scholars emphasize this title to highlight Noah’s unique spiritual rank and the theological principle that gratitude is the hallmark of true servitude to Allah, reinforcing the moral legacy passed down through the prophets.
